attempt_log: EXP-0006 operational UIC — contaminated by the administered queue
EXP-0007 corrected re-baseline — clean of contamination, still capability-starved
runnable-verification re-baseline — COMPLETE: the clean normal-runtime baseline; gap 2.44x cost / 2.12x uncached
open_decisions.resolution: REDESIGN THE INTERACTION MODEL. Runnable verification contracted the gap (cost 3.03x -> 2.44x, uncached 2.78x -> 2.12x) — capability starvation was a real amplifier — but the residual gap is materially >=2x with 4/4 tasks fully separated on cost (p=1.3e-5) and censoring biasing these numbers DOWN. Per the precommitted fork, LEAN_MANIFEST is the work; no further baseline refinement absent a measurement-invalidating defect.

open_decisions.decision: Did the Lean redesign preserve Gravito's control value while materially closing the economic gap?
open_decisions.open_uncertainty: Lean vs Current vs Native under the runnable environment: economics AND TOM-class collapse, judged simultaneously
open_decisions.resolved_by: 12 lean arms (T01-T04 x 3, runnable) against the existing 12 current and 12 native cells; frozen classifier; acceptance intact
attempt_log: decisive Native/Current/Lean, runnable, 12 lean arms — COMPLETE, 12/12 accepted
open_decisions.resolution: ARCHITECTURAL WIN (branch 1 of the precommitted fork). Lean: cost 1.10x native (current 2.26x), uncached 1.10x (2.05x), turns 1.09x. Uncached and control round-trips fully separated lean-below-current on 4/4 tasks; cost and turns on 3/4. Every TOM violation class collapsed to zero or near-zero: control round-trips 4.5->0.0, gate diagnosis 0.29->0, capability search 0.13->0, impl reads 2.0->0, gravito search 1.0->0, routing bookkeeping 1.17->0.08; repeat final reports 2.38->0.58 and text-only turns 11.7->4.5, both BELOW native. Acceptance 12/12 with verification executed in-band in every arm; zero timeouts. PROVISIONAL per P-provisional-measurement until adversarially validated.

open_decisions.decision: Does the bounded replication CONFIRM the lean architectural result, or reopen it?

open_decisions.resolved_by: one replication round: 12 lean arms, T01-T04 x reps 4-6, same pins, same classifier, same acceptance. Criteria precommitted by the operator: CONFIRM if acceptance/verification hold AND control interactions stay collapsed AND economics stay materially near native (1.18x or 1.25x still confirms); REOPEN only on reversion toward 1.8-2x+, returning control interactions, weakened acceptance, or wrong treatment identity
attempt_log: replication round, 12 lean arms reps 4-6 — COMPLETE, 12/12 accepted, 12/12 verified in-band
open_decisions.resolution: CONFIRMED, by the precommitted criteria applied mechanically: (1) acceptance 12/12 and verification executed in-band 12/12; (2) control interactions stayed collapsed — control round-trips 0.0 (4/4 tasks fully separated below current), gate diagnosis 0, capability search 0, routing bookkeeping 0.00, impl reads 0, gravito search 0; (3) economics near native — cost 1.26x (inside the operator's pre-declared 1.18-1.3x confirm band), uncached 1.18x, with cost separating lean-below-current on 4/4 tasks (stronger than the original draw's 3/4). No reversion toward 1.8-2x. The PROVISIONAL marker on D2 is LIFTED.

stop_conditions.rule: Once ONE clean normal-runtime baseline exists with verification runnable, stop re-baselining. If Gravito remains materially more expensive than native, move to interaction-model redesign. Reopening measurement afterwards requires a MEASUREMENT-INVALIDATING defect — proof the test did not measure what it claimed. A new plausible causal hypothesis is NOT grounds: it is interesting, and redesign comes first. Without this distinction every negative result generates one more rescue experiment forever.
stop_conditions.declared_by: operator, in-session, before the result was known
stop_conditions.satisfied_evidence: the clean normal-runtime baseline exists: 47 admissible arms, 47/47 accepted, verification proven executable in both arms. Task-paired cost gap 2.44x (4/4 tasks fully separated, p=1.3e-5), uncached 2.12x — materially above native, with censoring making these floors. Per the precommitted fork: stop re-baselining, redesign the interaction model.

policies.rule: Governance-feature expansion is FROZEN. No new controls unless they directly solve a measured blocker. The highest-value work is making what Gravito already knows cheap to use, not making it know more.
policies.note: The convergence gate predates this freeze and is the last controller admitted under it.

policies.rule: A first clean measurement is PROVISIONAL until adversarially validated. Grounds: five findings this program were overturned or materially reinterpreted by instrument or environment defects (EXP-0005 host asymmetry, vacuous isolation check, unstable implementation-read metric, administered queue contamination, capability starvation).
policies.declared_by: operator assessment, adopted as policy; not yet a wired control — wiring one would violate P-freeze-governance unless a measured blocker demands it
